s1.syndrome_frame: subacute weight loss and back pain with renal failure and possible infection
salient_findings: 40 pounds of weight loss over three months
key_facts: elevated lipase with normal liver function tests
positive urine culture for group B streptococcus
severe bilateral hydroureteronephrosis on CT abdomen/pelvis
discitis at L4-L5 level on MRI lumbar spine
acute and chronic inflammation with micro abscess formation on CT-guided spinal biopsy

raw.syndrome_frame: subacute weight loss and back pain with renal failure and possible infection
salient_findings: 40 pounds of weight loss over three months
key_facts: elevated lipase with normal liver function tests
positive urine culture for group B streptococcus
severe bilateral hydroureteronephrosis on CT abdomen/pelvis
discitis at L4-L5 level on MRI lumbar spine

shortlist.label: Spondylodiscitis
shortlist.why_kept: Discitis at L4-L5 level on MRI lumbar spine and acute and chronic inflammation with micro abscess formation on CT-guided spinal biopsy

shortlist.label: Pyelonephritis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive urine culture for group B streptococcus and severe bilateral hydroureteronephrosis on CT abdomen/pelvis

shortlist.label: Obstructive Uropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Severe bilateral hydroureteronephrosis on CT abdomen/pelvis and enlarged prostate

shortlist.label: Spinal Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Discitis at L4-L5 level on MRI lumbar spine and positive quantiferon gold

shortlist.label: Psoas Abscess
shortlist.why_kept: Myositis involving bilateral psoas muscles without abscess on MRI lumbar spine and positive COVID PCR

raw.rationale: The patient has discitis at the L4-L5 level on MRI lumbar spine, and the CT-guided spinal biopsy shows acute and chronic inflammation with micro abscess formation, which are key findings consistent with spondylodiscitis.

rejected.label: Pyelonephritis
rejected.why: While the patient has a positive urine culture for group B streptococcus, the primary findings of discitis and spinal biopsy results point more directly to spondylodiscitis.

rejected.label: Obstructive Uropathy
rejected.why: The patient's severe bilateral hydroureteronephrosis could be due to obstructive uropathy, but this does not directly explain the discitis and spinal biopsy results.

rejected.label: Spinal Tuberculosis
rejected.why: The positive quantiferon gold test suggests tuberculosis infection, but the biopsy results and imaging studies more specifically support spondylodiscitis, and there's no direct evidence of spinal tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Psoas Abscess
rejected.why: While the patient has myositis involving bilateral psoas muscles, the primary diagnosis of spondylodiscitis better explains the overall clinical and biopsy findings, and there's no direct evidence of a psoas abscess.

gold: Vertebral osteomyelitis and discitis due to Streptococcus cristatus
